name: deadlink-watchdog
description: API that monitors broken links in Nigerian websites

scripts.db:drop-tables: node -e "const { Sequelize } = require('sequelize'); const config = require('./config/database.js'); async function dropAll() { const sequelize = new Sequelize(config.development); try { await sequelize.authenticate(); console.log('🔗 Connected to database'); await sequelize.query('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS broken_links CASCADE;'); console.log('🗑️ Dropped broken_links'); await sequelize.query('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS crawl_results CASCADE;'); console.log('🗑️ Dropped crawl_results'); await sequelize.query('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS websites CASCADE;'); console.log('🗑️ Dropped websites'); await sequelize.query('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;'); console.log('🗑️ Dropped users'); await sequelize.query('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS \"SequelizeMeta\" CASCADE;'); console.log('🗑️ Dropped SequelizeMeta'); await sequelize.query('DROP TYPE IF EXISTS enum_users_role CASCADE;'); await sequelize.query('DROP TYPE IF EXISTS enum_websites_category CASCADE;'); await sequelize.query('DROP TYPE IF EXISTS enum_websites_crawlFrequency CASCADE;'); await sequelize.query('DROP TYPE IF EXISTS enum_crawl_results_status CASCADE;'); await sequelize.query('DROP TYPE IF EXISTS enum_broken_links_errorType CASCADE;'); console.log('🗑️ Dropped all enums'); console.log('✅ All tables dropped successfully!'); await sequelize.close(); } catch (error) { console.error('❌ Error:', error.message); process.exit(1); } } dropAll();"

author: DeadLink Watchdog Team
